card.name: Words before 'develop into' or 'grow into'
card.fires_on: Small words or verbs right before a verb of progression such as develop, grow, become or lead to, usually after a condition or lesion. Typical settings are cancer, precancer and disease progression.

modes.label: Progression into disease
modes.description: A modal or verb after a lesion or condition, just before 'develop into', 'lead to' or 'be a precursor to' cancer.
modes.example: It usually produces symptoms like genital warts that are unlikely to<< develop>> into cancer.

modes.label: Linking word before 'become'
modes.description: A linking word or adverb after a noun, just before a verb of change over time.
modes.example: the first national computer network that<< eventually>> became the Internet.

modes.label: Hypothetical harm
modes.description: A word such as never or would before a verb of harm developing.
modes.example: "trivial lesions" that would<< never>> have done any harm, Grossman explained

card.writes: It promotes growth words such as grew, grow and growing, which fits a next word about developing or growing.
card.plain: It fires on words just before a verb about something growing or developing into something else, such as a lesion turning into cancer.
